hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */install|*/.zshrc|*/.zprofile|*/.p10k.zsh) zsh -n "$f" || exit 2;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || exit 0; shellcheck -S warning -e SC1091 "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac; }
